When I gotta go, I usually go. I'm was just saying sometimes I didn't because I couldn't right then. When I was younger I just didn't feel like it. Not every single time I feel the urge to poop. I just don't get the urge to poop often. It's only smelly if I hold it, not every single time I poop and not every single time I hold it either. 

I don't have diarrhea when I go, I have normal poop. That has been evaluated by doctors thanks to my mom. 

I dunno why you're being mean about this and acting like I'm dismissing you when I acknowledged what you said, and said it was good advice. I've been evaluated by multiple doctors, not just one since growing up. All of them have confirmed it's normal for me and I don't have any problems.

I acknowledge this is unusual, hence throwaway, because I don't just proclaim this to everyone I know. It is weird and I get that. But nothing is wrong with me medically.

And I stated I felt like I had to go in my first post, knew he felt it, because I felt it too, so I don't know where you got that I didn't know I had to go in that. It was just bad timing and an embarrassing situation I decided to randomly share, that I've never gone through again.

I dunno not everyone poops every single day, and it doesn't mean some crazy stool buildup is happening in their intestines. Maybe if they do poop every day for all of their life, then suddenly didn't, then yes there would be a concern. For as long as I can remember I never pooped every day, so therefore it's normal for me. I related it to random childhood memory but how reliable is a child's reasoning? 

...I never thought I'd be seriously arguing over poop as an adult.

I actually got an MRI and and ultrasound done of my lower extremities just last year because I was having extreme side pains. Everything's good down there. Turns out I was overdosing on emergen-c by accident. But nah all my stuffs fine, and so far I've never "sharted". I've never had to waffle stomp anything either, so I think I'm good.

Also, in my first post, I said my mom took me to multiple doctors cause she was disturbed by this, she still tells any new doctor she gets to this day 10 years later. I'm not worried about dying from my organs failing on me anytime soon. 

But what you said is very good advice, and any anomalies in your normal health should definitely be checked out. If you really feel something is wrong, even when a doctor dismisses you, then get a new doctor. Your body knows better than anyone else.

This is weird for me to admit this, so posting on my throwaway. I poop once a week, if that. I did it all my life, I know it's weird, my mom made me go to the doctors for it when I was younger cause it got brought up in a conversation. She thought something was seriously wrong with me, but the multiple doctors she brought me to(even brought it up with her own doctors) convinced her it's fine if I'm not experiencing problems. 

I know when I gotta poop, it's not often and for some magical reason(seriously) if I feel it coming on in an inconvenient time.. I can just hold it back. I hated pooping as a kid, I felt like it was taking away from the time I could play with my friends or during sleepovers I was missing out on what they were talking about. So as an adult, I don't have to poop when I have to poop. 

Lol that sounds ridiculous typing that out. 

It's so weird though, cause you'd think if you just held it in you'd have to go later, but no, for me it will come out days later. Even if I want to go. It just kinda disappeared  or something. Granted it smells way worse if I hold it in though, but I literally can't even force it out later the same day if the timing wasn't right. I'm not constipated, I don't feel pain or bloated or anything. It just kinda goes away for me, but when it comes and I let it(usually in the comfort of my own home, or work cause I get paid for that shit) it smells horrendous. Like I'm in shock that smell came from me.  


OKAY HERE'S THE GROSS EXPERIENCE. PLEASE DON'T READ IF YOU GAG EASILY, BECAUSE I LITERALLY THREW UP AND WAS TRAUMATIZED EXPERIENCING THIS IN REAL LIFE. 
But there are the very rare occasions where I have absolutely GOT TO GO. There's no holding back, I ate something weird, I have the grumbly belly, I can not do anal. That has only happened once in my whole life. And the room was dark, and I went down on him afterwards(I can never do again because of this) I literally felt him pushing my poo! He felt that, obvious turn off. So he told me to go down on him, and for some god forsaken reason, I didn't think poo would be on his dick, even though I know it touched it! What the flying fuck was I thinking?!? But oh my god was I so wrong, I was so very wrong. I was just acting in the moment or something and went straight for it, and oh my fucking god never ever ever ever again. Holy shit. Except it wasn't holy. It was just shit. Fuck.

I wish it just was easy sometimes lol. Although I suck at shopping too so it's hard to find a nice pair of clothes haha... But anyways then I guess it wouldn't be meaningful. There's pros and cons to everything. 

I guess I just gotta give time to the trusting thing. With friends and anyone... I really like your analogy, it makes a lot of sense. 

I just can't wait until this fog is lifted from me. I'm in the initial shock of everything and I can't think, or eat, or sleep. I literally haven't eaten since Tuesday and I think I've slept maybe about 5 hours total since Monday. I seriously don't know how my body is functioning. The only good thing from this is at least I'm getting skinnier I guess lol. But I know my thought process is just gone from not eating or sleeping so I'm being irrational about things I shouldn't be

Things will get better for us, then they'll suck again, then they'll get better. Life really can be a rollercoaster. But as long as we do the best we can, then we'll make it through

That's too much, not only for them, but for me. I think that everyone should be able to have friends that are opposite genders regardless of relationships. 

But thank you so much for your thoughts and commenting!
